title: Plumeform section heading
description: A tracked-capitals eyebrow over a tight, bold Manrope title (36→48px, or 48→72px for page and hero titles) and slate body text; rises in with a soft blur as it scrolls into view.
notes: CSS scroll reveal; reveal={false} for a still heading
name: plumeform-heading

props.name: eyebrow
props.description: small tracked capitals above the title

props.name: title
props.description: the heading itself (may hold inline badges)

props.name: children
props.description: text under the title: a string or your own paragraphs

props.name: size
props.description: display: 60→72px (the hero) · page: 48→60px (a page title) · section: 36→48px

props.name: reveal
props.description: each part rises in as it scrolls into view
